Lighting/mood: Neutral soft studio lighting. Anguish, dread, and determined effort, entirely nonsexual.
Avoid: Eroticized suffering, restraints, injuries, sexual activity, goat motifs, Gothic ornament, duplicated limbs, malformed fingers, cropped extremities.
Create one new image only.
